**Finding: missing (deviation by omission) — TRANSITION**

The termination section (§ 6) is silent on exit mechanics. It covers only the 15-day notice rights, payment of Contractor's accrued fees, and assignment of Works in progress. Document-wide searches for "transition," "return," and "delet" returned nothing, and the confidentiality provision (§ 8, p0038–p0040) restricts use and disclosure but imposes no return or destruction duty. Section 4 gives us ownership of Works but no delivery-back mechanism.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new § 6(c) after p0033 requiring RadialSpark to (i) provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at then-current rates on request, (ii) return all Works, Company data and Confidential Information within thirty (30) days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and (iii) thereafter delete and certify deletion in writing. Language is adapted to this Agreement's defined terms (Company, Contractor, Works, Confidential Information) because "Customer Data" is not defined here. Fallback of 90 days' assistance is flagged in the comment.
